title: PHP Security Releases Fix Two Critical RCE Vulnerabilities
content:
PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote code execution. Here's who's at risk and how to update.

The post PHP Security Releases Fix Two Critical RCE Vulnerabilities appeared first on Laravel News.
